title: Federation mailbox participation test path needs 1.5–2 MiB of stack on master; box the large futures
outcome: On master, tests::federation_mailbox_participation::qualified_existing_roots_exchange_read_and_ack_without_join_or_activation needs between 1.5 and 2 MiB of test-thread stack in the debug build, so any small growth of a future on that path overflows the default 2 MiB stack. The large future or futures on that path (the qualified pair's sends, reads and acknowledgements through the federation RPC client and receiver, awaited inline on a current_thread runtime) are found and moved to the heap, for example with Box::pin, with no behaviour, timeout or limit change and without raising any stack size. Afterwards the test passes at the default stack and, as evidence of reclaimed headroom, also under RUST_MIN_STACK=1572864.
acceptance: Federation mailbox participation test path needs 1.5–2 MiB of stack on master; box the large futures is done
